high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "wionews." The post features a headline that reads: "Rohit Sharma's epic gesture to journalist during press conference goes viral." The text below the headline provides context about Rohit Sharma's reputation for making memorable replies and gestures during press conferences. The post describes a recent press conference held after Day One of a cricket match. A reporter asked Rohit Sharma if India beating England in the second Test would be a great reason for the whole country to celebrate the 75th Independence Day.
